current_claim: A seven-scale, eight-overlay, five-role Manzanita Works experience connecting household habitat, Street Glide, regional context, assistance, and Essential Attention.
mechanism: A governed place record is supposed to change aperture across plant, household, property, street, neighborhood, region, and stewardship while retaining registered sources, overlays, roles, authority, and handoff.

findings.title: The current production experience substitutes one authored illustration and crop changes for genuinely different scale apertures.
findings.mechanism: Labels, camera transforms, and callouts change while the underlying record, evidence, geometry, and safe action do not.
findings.acceptance: Each scale must reveal different source-bound objects, geometry, recency, uncertainty, lawful action, and handoff while retaining one registered place identity.

findings.title: The overlays are not registered to the transformed scene and the roles are primarily copy switches.
findings.mechanism: Image transforms and SVG overlays can drift apart; role controls can change prose without changing evidence aperture, authority, acceptance, or export.
findings.acceptance: Image, camera, overlays, and world coordinates move as one object; every role produces a distinct operational projection over the same canonical record.

findings.title: The production qualification encodes counts and static media rules rather than live source custody and visual fidelity.
findings.mechanism: Seven scales, eight overlays, five roles, and an estate-owned SVG can all exist while the site contains simplified imagery, clipped compact views, hidden navigation, stale data, or fabricated context.
findings.acceptance: Consume the qualified source foundation from draft PR #90, retain detailed visual standards, add registered street imagery and real live-data states, and rerun full-seat playtests.

assets_required: qualified place core and source registry from PR #90
real street imagery provider resolver and scene registration
distinct assets for all seven scale apertures
source, geometry, reading, action, and legend for all eight overlays
five seat-specific evidence and authority projections
detailed visual plates and typography goldens
compact-width, keyboard, touch, outage, stale-data, and low-bandwidth captures
next_gate: Merge no public successor until one source-backed place survives every scale, overlay, role, viewport, and source outage.
